en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a multi-story early 20th‑century building with a steep roof, dormer windows, and a small tower-like structure on top. The facade bears the word "Sparkasse" and the building sits behind a low fence with trees in the foreground. At the top left of the card is printed the caption "Altmittweida — Gemeindeamt." The overall style suggests a German small-town municipal/bank building.
